learning_objective: 🌱 Discover how plants grow, differentiate, and respond to environmental cues like light and temperature using powerful chemical messengers!

key_vocabulary.hindi_meaning: विभज्योतक (पौधे में लगातार वृद्धि करने वाले ऊतकों का क्षेत्र)
विभेदन (कोशिकाओं का विशिष्ट कार्य करने के लिए परिपक्व होना)
पादप हार्मोन (पौधों की वृद्धि को नियंत्रित करने वाले रसायन)
दीप्तिकालिता (दिन और रात की लंबाई के प्रति पौधों की प्रतिक्रिया, खासकर फूल खिलने में)
वसंतीकरण (कम तापमान देकर पौधों में जल्दी फूल लाने की प्रक्रिया)

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Plant growth is 'open' (continues throughout life) due to meristems. When cells stop dividing and mature to perform specific functions (like becoming xylem), it's called differentiation. If they regain the ability to divide, it's dedifferentiation.

PGRs are divided into two groups: Growth Promoters (Auxins, Gibberellins, Cytokinins) and Growth Inhibitors (Abscisic Acid, Ethylene). They are required in minute quantities to regulate physiological processes.

Auxins promote stem elongation and apical dominance (main stem grows, side branches stop). Gibberellins cause internode elongation (making dwarf plants tall). Cytokinins promote rapid cell division and delay leaf aging.

Ethylene is a unique gaseous hormone that speeds up fruit ripening (like making bananas yellow). Abscisic Acid (ABA) is the 'stress hormone'—it stops growth and closes stomata during severe droughts to save water.

Plants sense the length of day and night to know when to flower. Short Day Plants flower when nights are long (winter). Long Day Plants flower when days are long (summer). Day Neutral Plants don't care about the light duration.

fun_activity.title: ✂️ The Gardener's Trick
fun_activity.instructions: Ever wonder why gardeners trim the tops of hedges? The top bud produces 'Auxin', which suppresses the growth of side branches (Apical Dominance). By cutting off the top tip, you remove the auxin, allowing lateral branches to grow, making the bush wider and denser!

exam_tips: 📌 Charles Darwin and his son Francis discovered Auxin by studying the bending of canary grass coleoptiles towards light (phototropism).
📌 Gibberellic acid is famously used to increase the length of grape stalks and to increase the yield of sugarcane crops.
📌 'Vernalization' refers specifically to the dependence of flowering on prior exposure to a period of cold temperature.
quick_recap: ⭐ The discovery of Gibberellins started with the 'bakanae' (foolish seedling) disease of rice, caused by a fungus.
⭐ Ethylene is the most widely used PGR in agriculture because of its incredible effectiveness in ripening fruits.
⭐ Plasticity in plants means following different pathways in response to environment or phases of life (e.g., different leaf shapes in juvenile vs. mature cotton plants, called heterophylly).
